name: omafan
author: rob-d3v
description: Fan control for laptops through NBFC-Linux: temperatures, auto, presets, turbo, a manual speed slider and a silent mode for the night. A NitroSense-style panel for Acer Nitro and others. Unofficial community plugin.

barWidget.description: Fan icon that turns red when hot. Click opens the fan panel; right click shows the temperature in the bar.
